download_gnome_data: download GNoME data files from Google Cloud Storage to a chosen directory using wget
download_from_link: download a file from a public GCS link to a specified output directory using wget
run_download_script: run the download_data_wget script to fetch stable materials CSVs and zip archives to data/gnome_data
configure_data_dir: configure the data directory path for the download script via the --data_dir flag
download_license_file: download the LICENSE file from the GCS bucket to the specified data directory
